At the cooling rates of 20–300 °C/min, only full bainite appeared.
At 15°C/min, some ferrite was formed, while at 10°C/min, ferrite was formed rapidly.

The pattern analysis of the coarse precipitates indicated by arrows shows the composition of M23C6 (FCC). The chemical composition of the M23C6 phase was 59.12%Fe-23.25%Cr-6.76%Mo-4.48%Mn-6.4%C as measured by energy-dispersive X-ray (EDX) spectral analysis.
A fine circular precipitate was observed and identified as FCC MC by pattern analysis; EDX analysis shows the composition of MC (M = Nb, Ti).
